title: DevSecOps Engineer - Snowflake & CI/CD
description:
Job Summary We are looking for a DevSecOps & Data Engineer with minimum 5+ years in cloud or data engineering, including CI/CD and platform security experience to support secure, reliable delivery and operation of Investments data platform. The role owns environment automation, deployment controls, access, secrets, and monitoring while contributing hands-on to Snowflake, dbt, and Five Tran pipeline engineering under the offshore data lead. 
 Position Details Employment Type: Full time Work Mode: Work from Office Location: Coimbatore, India 
 Key Responsibilities Configure and maintain development, test/UAT, and production data environments with controlled configuration and access. Implement Git branching, pull request checks, automated testing, and CI/CD for dbt, Snowflake changes, and supported integration components. Automate repeatable provisioning and configuration where appropriate using approved infrastructure-as-code tools. Implement approved Snowflake roles, grants, service identities, masking controls, and least-privilege access. Manage secrets and credentials through approved secure stores; support rotation and prevent credential exposure in code or logs. Monitor Five Tran ingestion, dbt runs, Snowflake workloads, and integration jobs; configure actionable alerts and recovery procedures. Track Snowflake consumption and performance, investigate anomalies, and implement approved optimizations. Support ingestion and transformation development, SQL troubleshooting, reconciliation, and pipeline defect resolution. Maintain release evidence, deployment and rollback procedures, access records, and operational audit logs. Execute approved deployments and coordinate incident response, root cause analysis, runbooks, and production handover. Required Skills 5+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering, Data Engineering, DevOps, or related roles. Hands-on experience with Git and CI/CD tools, such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or comparable tooling. Strong SQL and scripting skills. Practical experience with Snowflake administration or engineering, and cloud security fundamentals. Experience deploying dbt projects and supporting scheduled data pipelines and Five Tran operations. Practical experience with RBAC, service accounts, secrets management, logging, monitoring, and controlled releases. Ability to troubleshoot data platform incidents and document reproducible deployment and recovery procedures. 
 Good to Have Experience with Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Key Vault, Terraform and Python. Exposure to Profisee and Power BI environment and deployment operations. Snowflake, Azure, or DevOps certifications. Experience delivering projects within regulated financial services environments. 
 Additional Requirements Strong written and verbal communication, structured documentation and ability to take ownership of assigned tasks. Availability for agreed overlap with US Central business hours and planned releases is expected.
